title: Validation recommendation and stop rules
objective: Write a stop rule for a validation dependent on an unapproved connector.
clearance: Rewritten draft; pending SME and partner clearance

blocks.x: Every validation needs a short written recommendation and clear rules for when to stop, narrow, or escalate. Without them, evaluations drift and expand.
Write a one-page recommendation that states:

items: **The chosen option**, and why lighter alternatives do or don't suffice.
**Evidence:** what will be measured or demonstrated.

blocks.x: Agree in advance what happens if things change. If a test fails because the intended source is unavailable, that calls for a decision about the dependency. It doesn't mean an automatic extension. Revisit the hypothesis, the scope, and the sponsor's commitment before investing more.

blocks.label: Boundary
blocks.x: Don't continue an evaluation indefinitely, and don't quietly expand data or users. Changes need agreement from the owners, a risk review, and updated decision criteria.
A recommendation is complete when someone outside the account could approve or reject it from the page alone.

blocks.title: A complete validation recommendation
blocks.alt: Six cards listing the parts of a validation recommendation: the buying question, the chosen option, the scope, the evidence it will produce, owners and dates, and the go or no-go criteria.

items.label: The chosen option
items.detail: And why it is the lightest sufficient one
